name: My First Real Potion
summary: A child asks you to bring murloc eyes for My First Real Potion. She is eager to mix it herself.

sections.title: A First Attempt
sections.body: The child is glad to see the murloc eyes. While you were away, she gathered more herbs and found empty vials downstairs. Now she asks you to mix the ingredients as she watches. The potion turns sickly orange when the eyes go in.

faq.answer: The child wants murloc eyes for her first real potion, along with herbs and empty vials.
You mix the potion while the child watches.

faq.q: What color does the potion turn?
faq.answer: The mixture turns sickly orange within seconds of adding the murloc eyes.
No. The child says she would not drink the potion, but gives you her recipe.

attribution: In-game quest text: My First Real Potion
